artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: shared link resolver in lib/sapience-api-lib.sh, read-side project_cid in sapience-retrieve.sh with a pre-pinned no-link negative control, per-repo-scoping.md design statement, and a closing verification phase; write-side project_cid excluded per sf1-engine Ruling 7.

memory_candidates.content: The sapience extension's worktree-checkout-resolution block is pinned byte-identical across NINE copies, not five: test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh Case 30's LOCKSTEP_FILES array names the MCP registration hook, verify-sapience-mcp.sh, and seven slug-deriving scripts (sapience-retrieve.sh, sapience-remember.sh, verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh, sapience-project-bind.sh, sapience-vault-read.sh, sapience-publish.sh, sapience-tag-pending.sh). Several scripts' own headers still describe a five-copy set, so the figure must be re-derived from Case 30's array rather than from any script comment or report. Any new sapience script needing a checkout toplevel either adds a tenth copy AND joins that array, or -- preferably -- takes an already-resolved toplevel as a parameter and adds no copy at all.
